dispatcher.whenToUse: Use for Stage 2 (Routing and assignment) of the seven-stage lifecycle — classify the goal, set priority, record ownership and confidence. The paper names this role first; no goal skips the dispatch.

researcher.whenToUse: Use for Stage 3 (Context gathering) when uncertainty is high — reduce uncertainty before a decision lands, surface alternatives with trade-offs, land findings in the durable record. The paper: the Researcher leads when uncertainty is high.

builder.whenToUse: Use for Stage 4 (Action) when the goal is to produce a durable artefact — code, document, schema, configuration, dataset. Self-validate before handing off to the Verifier.

runtime.whenToUse: Use for Stage 4 (Action) when the goal is to operate a live system — deploy, migrate, scale, restart, configure. Must hold a tested rollback plan and stay inside the safe tier.

verifier.whenToUse: Use for Stage 5 (Verification) — independent validation gate before integration or deployment. Define the green gate, re-run evidence where possible, post a verdict. The paper: a verifier who always passes is not a verifier.

archivist.whenToUse: Use for Stage 6 (Recording and archival) and the ownership-transfer half of Stage 7 (Hand-off or closure) — append-only durable record, index for retrieval, surface recurring lessons as skills.
